tldr: 台股10月7日收49,806點，盤中逼近5萬點僅差34點後拉回。
鴻海9月營收首度單月破兆、年增38%，AI伺服器與iPhone新機帶動改寫紀錄。
財政部10月8日公布9月出口，預估年增42%至48%、連35紅改寫最長紀錄。
美股10月7日自高點回落，10年期美債殖利率創24年新高、Fed會議紀要偏鷹。
壽險接軌TIS與匯率會計新制，銀行在亞洲資產管理中心政策下擴大高資產財管。

items.title_zh: 台股攻頂失利收49,806點、小跌16點
items.title_en: TAIEX stalls just short of 50,000 as it edges down 16 points
items.summary_zh: 台股10月7日加權指數終場收49,806.37點，小跌16.18點、跌幅0.03%，成交值9,259.92億元。盤中一度攻抵49,966點，距離5萬點大關僅差34點，但買盤追高意願保守、獲利了結賣壓湧現使指數拉回。顯示大盤雖維持歷史高檔，但5萬點整數關卡壓力浮現，短線進入高檔震盪格局。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX closed at 49,806.37 on Oct 7, down a marginal 16.18 points (-0.03%), on turnover of NT$925.99 billion. The index pushed intraday to 49,966, only 34 points shy of the 50,000 milestone, before profit-taking dragged it back. The near-miss underscores strong momentum but also rising resistance as investors lock in gains near record highs.

items.title_zh: 權值股分化：台積電平盤2,585元、聯發科挫85元
items.title_en: Heavyweights split: TSMC flat at NT$2,585, MediaTek slides NT$85
items.summary_zh: 權值股10月7日表現分化：台積電開低走低一度下跌20元，終場靠尾盤2,176張買單拉回、以平盤2,585元作收；聯發科則重挫85元至4,835元。龍頭股走勢分歧壓抑大盤攻頂力道，反映資金在高檔轉趨選擇性布局，而非全面追逐半導體類股，使指數在5萬點前陷入拉鋸。
items.summary_en: Large-cap tech diverged on Oct 7. TSMC swung to a flat close at NT$2,585 after a late 2,176-lot buy order erased an earlier drop, while MediaTek tumbled NT$85 to NT$4,835. The split among leading names capped the index and signals investors are rotating selectively rather than chasing the whole chip sector into record territory.

items.title_zh: 鴻海9月營收首度單月破兆，寫台灣企業新猷
items.title_en: Foxconn becomes first Taiwan firm to clear NT$1 trillion in monthly revenue
items.summary_zh: 鴻海公布9月營收1兆1,586億元，月增25.7%、年增38.42%，成為台灣史上首家單月營收破兆的企業；第三季營收3兆269億元、年增47.12%，優於市場預期。主要動能來自AI伺服器拉貨與iPhone新機上市雙引擎。鴻海看好AI營運與ICT旺季延續至第四季，完整財報將於11月12日公布，市場聚焦營收能否轉化為獲利。
items.summary_en: Foxconn (Hon Hai) posted September revenue of NT$1.159 trillion, the first time any Taiwanese company has topped NT$1 trillion in a single month, up 25.7% from August and 38.4% year-on-year. Third-quarter revenue reached NT$3.03 trillion, up 47% year-on-year and beating estimates, driven by AI server shipments and the new iPhone launch. Management expects AI-led growth to continue into Q4.

items.title_zh: 技嘉9月營收年增125%創高，AI伺服器需求強勁
items.title_en: Gigabyte September revenue jumps 125% to record on AI-server demand
items.summary_zh: 技嘉9月合併營收630.99億元，年增125.45%，單月與第三季營收同創歷史新高，反映AI伺服器與GPU平台需求持續強勁。繼鴻海單月營收破兆後，技嘉等供應鏈業者同步交出亮眼成績，顯示台灣AI硬體供應鏈第三季維持高速運轉，持續扮演支撐出口與台股表現的核心引擎，也強化市場對下半年AI行情的信心。
items.summary_en: Gigabyte reported September revenue of NT$63.1 billion, surging 125% year-on-year to a record monthly and quarterly high, as demand for AI servers and GPU platforms stayed robust. Coming right after Foxconn's trillion-dollar month, the figure adds to evidence that Taiwan's AI hardware supply chain remained in full swing through the third quarter, reinforcing its role as the main driver of the island's export and equity-market strength.

items.title_zh: 壽險接軌TIS清償新制，金管會訂三項揭露規範
items.title_en: Insurers move to new TIS solvency regime with three FSC disclosure rules
items.summary_zh: 壽險業2026年起接軌新一代清償能力制度（TIS），取代舊有RBC制，以更貼近市場方式衡量資產、負債與風險。金管會對資本適足率揭露訂三原則：以目標值為上限、禁止排名比較、未達標須加註說明。首張以9月底為基準的TIS成績單可望全員過關。新制有助提升壽險財務透明度，但也考驗業者資本韌性，牽動後續配息與增資規劃。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's insurers switched to the new Taiwan Insurance Solvency (TIS) regime in 2026, replacing the old RBC framework with a more market-based measure of assets, liabilities and risk. The FSC set three disclosure rules—capping reported ratios at a target value, banning peer rankings, and requiring explanatory notes for shortfalls. The first TIS scorecard, based on end-September figures, is expected to see all life insurers pass.

items.title_zh: 匯率會計新制上路，壽險年省約900億避險成本
items.title_en: FX accounting rule to save insurers ~NT$90bn a year in hedging costs
items.summary_zh: 金管會匯率會計新制2026年上路，壽險業長期持有的海外債券匯率影響，改依剩餘年限逐年攤銷，不再每月全額認列，業界估計每年可省約900億元避險成本，但須先提存至一定水位才能按比例計入資本。截至3月底，壽險業外匯價格變動準備金達9,111億元、國外投資避險比率45.15%。新制可望緩解匯率波動對壽險獲利與資本的衝擊。
items.summary_en: A new foreign-exchange accounting rule effective in 2026 lets life insurers amortize the FX impact of long-term overseas bonds over their remaining maturity, rather than booking it fully each month. The change is estimated to save the industry about NT$90 billion a year in hedging costs, though gains must first be provisioned. At end-March, insurers' FX reserve stood at NT$911.1 billion with a 45.15% hedge ratio.

items.title_zh: 銀行搶攻高資產，亞洲資產管理中心加速財管升級
items.title_en: Banks race to build high-net-worth services under Asian Asset Management Center push
items.summary_zh: 在政府推動的「亞洲資產管理中心」政策下，國銀積極搶攻高資產財富管理。國泰、中信、玉山等已於高雄專區啟動試辦業務，涵蓋跨境資產配置、財務融資與家族辦公室諮詢，服務門檻約新台幣1億元。此布局意在把高資產客戶資金留在境內、深化私人銀行市場，預期將加速財管服務升級與跨業整合，並帶動信託、保險等傳承工具需求。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's major banks are expanding high-net-worth services under the government's Asian Asset Management Center initiative. Cathay, CTBC and Yushan have launched pilot programs in the Kaohsiung zone covering cross-border asset allocation, financing and family-office advisory, with entry thresholds around NT$100 million. The push aims to keep wealthy clients' assets onshore and deepen Taiwan's private-banking market.

items.title_zh: 報告：2026年高資產族群估達12.4萬人、持有46兆元
items.title_en: High-net-worth population to reach 124,000 holding NT$46tn in 2026, report says
items.summary_zh: 據KPMG與玉山報告，台灣淨資產逾1億元的高資產族群由2023年的9.3萬人增至2025年的11.8萬人，合計持有43.7兆元，並預估2026年達12.4萬人、資產約46.1兆元。ETF與高資產財管是推升市場規模的主要引擎；逾七成高資產客戶已布局境外資產、85%已進行或準備傳承規劃，顯示財富管理需求由單純投資轉向跨境配置與家族傳承整合。
items.summary_en: A KPMG–Yushan report estimates Taiwan's high-net-worth population—those with over NT$100 million in assets—rose from 93,000 in 2023 to 118,000 in 2025, holding NT$43.7 trillion combined, and projects 124,000 people with NT$46.1 trillion in 2026. ETFs and HNW wealth management are cited as key growth engines; over 70% of such clients already hold offshore assets and 85% are planning wealth succession.

items.title_zh: 9月出口今日公布，連35紅拚史上最長上升周期
items.title_en: September exports set for 35th straight monthly gain as data lands Oct 8
items.summary_zh: 財政部10月8日將公布9月進出口統計，預估出口值介於770億至803億美元、年增42%至48%，篤定寫下連續第35個月正成長，改寫史上最長上升周期。出口續強由AI與科技需求帶動，並使第3季出口創單季新高幾乎底定；8月出口已達824億美元、創歷年單月新高，為全年經濟成長提供強勁支撐。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's finance ministry is set to release September trade data on Oct 8, with exports estimated at US$77-80.3 billion, up 42-48% year-on-year. That would mark a 35th straight month of growth—the longest streak on record—driven by AI and tech demand, and all but lock in a record third quarter. August exports had already hit an all-time monthly high of US$82.4 billion.

items.title_zh: 出口熱潮轉結構性，對等關稅降至15%化解變數
items.title_en: Taiwan's export boom turns structural as 15% U.S. tariff removes overhang
items.summary_zh: 台灣出口熱潮具結構性支撐：2026年上半年出口年增47%，其中電子與資通訊產品大增63.5%為主力。今年1月台美談定對等關稅降至15%，與日、韓、歐盟齊平，化解重大變數。在AI、高效能運算與先進製程需求強勁下，各機構對台灣全年經濟成長維持樂觀，惟須留意基期墊高與地緣政治風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's export surge looks structural: first-half 2026 exports jumped 47%, led by a 63.5% rise in electronics and ICT. A trade deal in January set Taiwan's U.S. reciprocal tariff at 15%, on par with Japan, South Korea and the EU, easing a key overhang. Robust AI, HPC and advanced-chip demand underpins upbeat full-year growth forecasts, though a high base and geopolitical risks remain watch points.

items.title_zh: 台媒：美債殖利率衝24年高點，美股自高檔回落
items.title_en: Taiwan media: U.S. stocks slip from records as Treasury yields hit 24-year high
items.summary_zh: 據台灣媒體報導，美股10月7日收低，標普500與那斯達克自歷史新高回落，主因美債殖利率飆至24年高點。報導指出，長天期殖利率攀升已成為由AI樂觀情緒推動的美股多頭當前最大風險，市場氣氛轉趨謹慎，並牽動亞股後市與資金動向。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media reported that U.S. stocks closed lower on Oct 7, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq retreating from record highs as the Treasury yield surged to a 24-year peak. The report flagged rising long-term yields as the key risk now facing a Wall Street rally that had been powered by AI optimism, souring sentiment and weighing on Asian market expectations.

items.title_zh: 台媒：油價再破百美元，30年期美債殖利率攀24年高點
items.title_en: Taiwan media: oil tops US$100 again as 30-year yield climbs to 24-year high
items.summary_zh: 鉅亨網報導，國際油價再度突破每桶100美元，30年期美國公債殖利率同步攀回24年高點。葉門叛軍攻擊沙烏地機場、荷姆茲海峽緊張情勢再起，推升布蘭特原油逼近102美元，重新點燃中東供應疑慮，並加重市場對通膨與債市的壓力，不利風險性資產表現。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Anue reported that oil prices again topped US$100 a barrel while the 30-year U.S. Treasury yield climbed back to a 24-year high. Brent crude pushed toward US$102 after Houthi attacks on Saudi airports and tensions in the Strait of Hormuz revived Middle East supply fears, adding to inflation and bond-market pressures and dampening risk appetite.

items.title_zh: 美股自歷史高點回落，債市波動施壓（2026-10-07）
items.title_en: U.S. stocks retreat from record highs on bond-market jitters (2026-10-07)
items.summary_zh: 美股10月7日自歷史高點回落，道瓊下跌341點、跌幅0.66%收51,179.87點，標普500與那斯達克各跌約0.22%，分別收7,801.77點與27,538.69點。美債殖利率攀升與油價走強施壓股市，小型股跌幅居前，顯示資金在高檔轉趨審慎。
items.summary_en: U.S. stocks slipped on Oct 7 as Wall Street pulled back from record highs. The Dow fell 341 points (-0.66%) to 51,179.87, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq each eased about 0.22% to 7,801.77 and 27,538.69. Rising Treasury yields and firmer oil prices pressured equities, with small caps leading declines as investors turned cautious near all-time highs.

items.title_zh: 10年期美債殖利率創24年高點，標售後回落（2026-10-07）
items.title_en: 10-year Treasury yield hits 24-year high before auction eases demand fears (2026-10-07)
items.summary_zh: 美國10年期公債殖利率一度衝上5.35%、創2002年以來最高，隨後因390億美元標售買盤穩健而回落，但得標利率仍創2000年來新高；30年期殖利率逼近24年高點、約5.67%。長天期殖利率飆升震盪股市，並再度點燃市場對美國政府債務與通膨的疑慮。
items.summary_en: The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield spiked to 5.35%, its highest since 2002, before easing after a solid US$39 billion auction that still cleared at the highest yield since 2000. The 30-year traded near a 24-year high at 5.67%. Surging long-term yields are rattling equities and reviving worries over U.S. government debt and inflation.

items.title_zh: Fed會議紀要：多數官員傾向年底前再升息一次（2026-10-07）
items.title_en: Fed minutes show most officials eye another rate hike by year-end (2026-10-07)
items.summary_zh: 聯準會10月7日公布9月會議紀要，多數官員認為今年底前可能還需再升息一次，理由是通膨上行風險與AI投資帶動的強勁需求。聯準會已於9月16日將基準利率升至3.75%至4.00%。偏鷹語調強化公債殖利率升勢，下次利率決策訂於10月28日，牽動後續市場走向。
items.summary_en: Minutes from the Fed's September meeting, released Oct 7, showed most officials thought another rate increase would likely be appropriate by year-end, citing upside inflation risks and resilient, AI-fueled demand. The Fed had raised its target range to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept 16. The hawkish tone reinforced the back-up in bond yields; the next decision is Oct 28.

items.title_zh: 金價站穩4,150美元，殖利率回落靜待Fed紀要（2026-10-06）
items.title_en: Gold holds above US$4,150 as yields ease and traders await Fed minutes (2026-10-06)
items.summary_zh: 國際金價10月6日穩守每盎司4,150美元之上，投資人靜待聯準會會議紀要，公債殖利率回落為金價提供支撐。避險需求、各國央行買盤，以及政府債務與中東緊張情勢的疑慮，使金價持續徘徊歷史高檔，但強勢美元與偏高的實質利率限制了進一步漲幅。
items.summary_en: Gold held firm above US$4,150 an ounce on Oct 6 as traders awaited the Fed minutes, with a pullback in bond yields lending support. Safe-haven demand, central-bank buying and worries over government debt and Middle East tensions have kept bullion near historic highs, even as a stronger dollar and elevated real yields cap further gains.
